title: Kissed Roasted Portuguese Peas Wrap
description: A romantic and snappy Portuguese dish featuring roasted peas, shio-koji-cure, and gluten-free-friendly ingredients, all wrapped in a ti-leaf vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, toss the peas with shio-koji, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the peas on a baking sheet and roast for 15 minutes or until they are tender and lightly browned.
While the peas are roasting, prepare the ti leaves by washing and drying them.
Once the peas are done, let them cool for a few minutes.
Spoon the roasted peas onto the center of each ti leaf.
Sprinkle a pinch of gluten-free flour over the peas.
Fold the ti leaves over the filling to form a wrap.
Serve the Kissed Roasted Portuguese Peas Wrap immediately.
Garnish with fresh herbs or edible flowers if desired.
